description: Rank the site-and-risk-status groups by share of scans and return every group whose share reaches the 10th-ranked share, including all ties.

c.request: Matching each scan to its site by site code (dropping scans with no matching site), group the scans by site code (`scans.zoneref`) and risk evaluation status (`riskeval`). For each group give the site code, the risk evaluation status, the average compression ratio (`pressratio`, ignoring missing values), the number of scans, and that number as a share of all matched scans. Show the top 10 by share, largest first. Don't round. Rank the site-and-risk-status groups by share of scans and return every group whose share reaches the 10th-ranked share, including all ties.
c.sql: WITH matched_scans AS (SELECT sc.zoneref, sc.pressratio, si.riskeval FROM scans sc INNER JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry), grouped_data AS (SELECT zoneref, riskeval, AVG(pressratio) as avg_compression, COUNT(*) as scan_count FROM matched_scans GROUP BY zoneref, riskeval), total_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_scans FROM matched_scans), with_share AS (SELECT zoneref, riskeval, avg_compression, scan_count, scan_count * 1.0 / tc.total_scans as share FROM grouped_data, total_count tc), ranked AS (SELECT zoneref, riskeval, avg_compression, scan_count, share, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) as rn FROM with_share) SELECT zoneref, riskeval, avg_compression, scan_count, share FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 10 OR share = (SELECT share FROM ranked WHERE rn = 10) ORDER BY share DESC, zoneref, riskeval

b.request: Return all site-code and risk-evaluation-status groups whose share of matched scans is at least as high as the 10th-ranked group's share when groups are ranked by descending share.
b.sql:
WITH scan_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    COUNT(*) as scan_count
  FROM scans
  WHERE zoneref IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY zoneref
),
site_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.riskeval,
    COALESCE(sc.scan_count, 0) as scan_count
  FROM sites s
  LEFT JOIN scan_counts sc ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
),
total_scans AS (
  SELECT SUM(scan_count) as total FROM site_groups WHERE scan_count > 0
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sg.zoneregistry,
    sg.riskeval,
    sg.scan_count::float / ts.total as share,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sg.scan_count::float / ts.total DESC) as rank
  FROM site_groups sg, total_scans ts
  WHERE sg.scan_count > 0
),
tenth_or_min AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT share FROM with_shares WHERE rank = 10),
    (SELECT MIN(share) FROM with_shares)
  ) as threshold
)
SELECT zoneregistry, riskeval
FROM with_shares
WHERE share >= (SELECT threshold FROM tenth_or_min)
ORDER BY share DESC;
b.raw: Return all site-code and risk-evaluation-status groups whose share of matched scans is at least as high as the 10th-ranked group's share when groups are ranked by descending share.

d.request: Group scans by (site code, risk evaluation status) after matching to sites and excluding unmatched scans; for each group calculate average compression ratio, scan count, and share of all matched scans; rank by share descending; return all groups with share ≥ the 10th-ranked group's share.
d.sql: WITH matched_scans AS (SELECT s.zoneref, si.riskeval, s.pressratio FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry), grouped AS (SELECT zoneref, riskeval, AVG(pressratio) as avg_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) as scan_count FROM matched_scans GROUP BY zoneref, riskeval), with_share AS (SELECT zoneref, riskeval, avg_compression_ratio, scan_count, scan_count * 1.0 / SUM(scan_count) OVER () as share, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY scan_count * 1.0 / SUM(scan_count) OVER () DESC) as rank FROM grouped) SELECT zoneref, riskeval, avg_compression_ratio, scan_count, share FROM with_share WHERE share >= COALESCE((SELECT share FROM with_share WHERE rank = 10), 0) ORDER BY share DESC

a.request: Matching each scan to its site by site code (dropping scans with no matching site), group the scans by site code (`scans.zoneref`) and risk evaluation status (`riskeval`). For each group give the site code, the risk evaluation status, the average compression ratio (`pressratio`, ignoring missing values), the number of scans, and that number as a share of all matched scans. Sort by share from largest to smallest and keep the top 10 rows plus every group whose share ties with the 10th one, even if that gives more than 10 rows. Don't round.
a.sql: WITH matched_scans AS (SELECT s.zoneref, s.pressratio, si.riskeval FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry), grouped_data AS (SELECT zoneref, riskeval, AVG(pressratio) as avg_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) as num_scans, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched_scans) as share FROM matched_scans GROUP BY zoneref, riskeval), ordered_groups AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) as row_num FROM grouped_data) SELECT zoneref, riskeval, avg_compression_ratio, num_scans, share FROM ordered_groups WHERE row_num <= 10 OR share = (SELECT share FROM ordered_groups WHERE row_num = 10 LIMIT 1) ORDER BY share DESC
